name: Default
shortDescription: Identity-aware access proxy that puts sign-in and per-route policies in front of internal apps, without a VPN.

alerts.message: Edit config.yaml and replace you@example.com with the email you sign in with, then redeploy; anyone else gets a 403. Sign-in uses the free Pomerium hosted authenticate service (email, Google or GitHub) until you configure your own identity provider on a separate authenticate domain.

Official Pomerium images from v0.34 ship under the Pomerium Community Edition License: free for individuals and organizations under US$10M yearly revenue and 100 staff, otherwise a commercial license or a self-built image is required.
